an3.43:1.1: “Bhikkhus, when one sees three advantages, it is enough to teach others the Dhamma.
an3.43:1.3: (1) The one who teaches the Dhamma experiences the meaning and the Dhamma.
an3.43:1.4: (2) The one who hears the Dhamma experiences the meaning and the Dhamma.
an3.43:1.5: (3) Both the one who teaches the Dhamma and the one who hears the Dhamma experience the meaning and the Dhamma.
an3.43:1.6: Seeing these three advantages, it is enough to teach others the Dhamma.”
